gaps.finding: The wrapper remains a 27px pill, controls remain 20px-radius circles, .vstep-plus remains #7C5CFF, and both actual controls are 40x40 with no button semantics or keyboard parity.

closureRequirements: No implementation PASS may be issued from this audit.
Repair shared families, not route-local screenshots or only .cvbuy/.vstep-plus.

Fresh QA must open CardViewer from Build list, grid and tray; standalone Detail image and text; and an Event-originated detail journey, with fallback overlay explicitly fixture-tested if navigation failure is not naturally reproducible.
Fresh QA must cover build/deck modes, price/buy, zero/positive/max quantity, previous/next wrap, zoom opening/front/back/closing, focus/keyboard, >=44px targets and reduced motion.
Six-route default/state regression and zero-write safety remain required.
